mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust household demand for housing, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation expectations, triggering aggressive monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain recovery (indicated by rising industrial production, INDPRO), manufacturing output expansion reduces input costs and boosts corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation that delays monetary policy easing, leading to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market overheating that accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting aggressive Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust housing market activity that drives consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both increase, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (characterized by strong GDP growth), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market saturation that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
